name: NY-08
label: Safe D

model.rationale: Hakeem Jeffries, the House Democratic leader, holds a D+24 Brooklyn seat with massive fundraising and no meaningful opposition spending; the baseline margin of ~27 points is well supported by fundamentals.
model.watch: Only a major scandal or redistricting shock could put this seat in play.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
NY-08 is a heavily Democratic Brooklyn district with a partisan lean of about D+24. Hakeem Jeffries, the House Democratic leader, is running for reelection with roughly $15 million raised and $5 million on hand, while Republican Lewis Mizrahi has no reported fundraising or cash. No outside groups are spending against the incumbent, and no general-election polls exist for the race.

The quantitative baseline puts the expected margin near 27 points, combining the district lean, a favorable national environment, incumbency, and money advantages. Prediction markets price Jeffries around 97 percent. With a weakly funded, little-known challenger and no contrary evidence, this race is rated Safe Democratic with high confidence.
